messages:
Morgan: Quick FYI — FluxFoods token usage dropped sharply this week, looks correlated with two new execs onboarding (new CFO + interim Head of Eng). They also kicked off a short pilot with a competitor last Friday. :eyes:
Priya: Do we have numbers? who from Flux raised the competitor pilot?
Morgan: From our notes: procurement pinged Priya (CC) and mentioned 'MuseAI' trial for restaurant menu parsing. Usage: weekly tokens down ~72% vs 30-day rolling avg.
Diego: Could be a client-side switch to the pilot endpoint. Any recent changelog or auth key rotations?
Elena: Pulled quick query from billing/dashboard — here's the 7d KPI snapshot:```
date, tokens
2024-07-01, 1,248,772
2024-07-02, 1,102,334
2024-07-03, 320,112
2024-07-04, 175,201
2024-07-05, 354,800
2024-07-06, 410,120
2024-07-07, 310,980
```
Elena: Link to full dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/fluxfoods/usage (internal).
Sam: Support side — no recent incidents in their workspace. Last support ticket two weeks ago for latency, resolved. No API key rotation on our end.
Priya: I spoke to procurement contact (Amina) earlier — they're evaluating pricing and accuracy. She called out faster token costs on MuseAI and wanted an apples-to-apples comparison.
Diego: Suggestion: propose a 2-week accuracy re-run on their canonical prompt set + a cost-savings plan (quantization + caching) we can show.
Morgan: Agreed. Also we should book an enablement session for the new CFO + Head of Eng. Quick agenda: 1) usage trends + ROI, 2) cost levers, 3) integration checklist.
Priya: I'll loop in legal/procurement and send a calendar invite. Proposed owners: Priya (commercial + procurement), Diego (technical demo), Morgan (CS lead), Elena (usage slides).
RenewalsBot: Reminder — FluxFoods renewal in 90 days. Renewal health flagged: at-risk (usage decline + competitor pilot).
Morgan: Action items: Priya to confirm pilot details by EOD, Diego to prepare accuracy/cost slides by Tue, Elena to export prompt-set eval by EOD, Morgan to schedule exec briefing for next Thu.
Priya: EOD update — procurement confirmed MuseAI pilot is limited to 2 models and a 10k requests eval. CFO wants cost delta first.
Diego: Noted. I'll pre-run a 2-model evaluation on their sample set and include per-inference cost breakdown.
Sam: If they want a sandbox token migration test, support can spin a short-lived key and capture latency/throughput.
Morgan: Great. Let's treat this as a canary churn risk — short window but actionable. I'll post a quick summary in #renewals after we have the slides. :thumbsup:
Priya: On it.
Diego: Will ping when eval ready.
Elena: Exported prompt set and attached to the invite draft.
Morgan: Thanks team — putting owners on those items. Follow-ups in thread.
